newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Jupiters in Keno deal with state govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Jupiters in Keno deal with state govt.

text.p: Casino and hotel group Jupiters Ltd said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement with the Queensland government which would allow it to launch the gambling game, Keno, throughout the state of Queensland.

"The signing of the Keno Agreement between Jupiters Ltd and the State Government under the Keno Act of 1996 will mean the game will soon become available through clubs, hotels and Totaliser Agency Boards (TABs) in Queensland," the company said. Jupiters currently operates Keno at its casinos on the Gold Coast and in Brisbane.
"We estimate Jupiters Keno will create at least 250 new jobs in our state and many of these will be in regional Queensland," Jupiters managing director, Richard Barnes said.
Jumpiters said a new division, Jupiters Network Gaming, would operate the game under supervision of the Queensland Office of Gaming Regulation.
Barnes said the introduction of Jupiters Keno would give the company enormous benefits through diversification from casino floor gaming to state-wide electronic gaming.
"I definitely expect Jupiters Keno to be a strong revenue earner for us", Barnes said.
Jupiters shares closed five cents weaker at A$2.85 on Tuesday.
